project_context.description: Official site of artist/producer BIOXIC (remixed manele + 'Manele Artificiale' AI concept).
project_context.theme: Dark mode, toxic/neon green on almost black, cinematic futuristic bio-toxic cyber vibe.
project_context.target_audience: Mobile-first, TikTok-driven fan base. Needs to be extremely responsive and high-performance.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase

usage.headings: Orbitron, always uppercase or highly stylized, tight tracking.
usage.body: Inter, left-aligned for readability, loose line-height.
usage.labels: Inter, uppercase, wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]) for overlines and tags.

effects.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:border-[#39FF14]/40 transition-colors
effects.noise: Subtle grain texture overlay fixed over the entire background (opacity 0.03 to 0.05).
effects.glitch_hover: Custom CSS keyframe animation on title hover simulating a digital glitch (color shifts to #39FF14 and slightly translates).
effects.scanlines: Repeating linear-gradient simulating CRT or cyber scanlines over hero sections (very low opacity).
effects.particles: Use tsparticles for slow, floating toxic green particles in the background.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for sections. Gap-6 or gap-8 in grids.
layouts.grids: Bento-style grids for the home page sections (AI vs Remix cards). Music grid 1 col mobile, 2-3 col desktop.
layouts.alignment: Mobile-first. Left-align text for readability, center only for hero headings if needed.
layouts.navigation: Sticky glassmorphic top nav (z-50) with #050805/80 background and blur. No fully transparent navs.

components.buttons: Sharp edges or very slight rounding (rounded-sm). Dark background with #39FF14 border, on hover fill with #39FF14 and turn text black.
components.audio_player: Persistent bottom bar (fixed bottom-0, z-50). Glassmorphism background, toxic green progress bar.
components.cards: Glassmorphism, 1px inner border. Image at top, padding for text. Hover state adds #39FF14 glow box-shadow.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI customized: background #050805, border white/20, focus:border-[#39FF14] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#39FF14].

pages_and_features.Intro: Cinematic overlay. Shows 'Infection Effect' logo, skip button. Use sessionStorage to show only once.
pages_and_features.Home: Hero with dark background, neon green accents. YouTube stats (static fallback). Latest videos grid (RSS mockup). Split cards: 'Manele Remixate' vs 'Manele Artificiale (AI)'.
pages_and_features.Muzica: Tracklist with filters (Remixuri, AI, Colaborari, Noi). Like button, listen counter. Play button triggers persistent bottom player.
pages_and_features.Live: Embed YouTube Live. Realtime chat UI (mocked via sockets/state), floating reaction emojis, viewer count, schedule.
pages_and_features.Videoclipuri: Gallery of thumbnails opening in a Lightbox video player.
pages_and_features.Despre: Story of BIOXIC. Quote by Nicolae Guta. Collaborators list (AMMA, Big Up Music, Nek Music). Timeline.
pages_and_features.Admin: Dashboard. Login, Track CRUD (upload audio/cover mockup), Live mode toggle, Moderation, Stats.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark toxic theme: Backgrounds are #050805, accents are #39FF14.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn rounded styles for main visual elements (buttons, cards). Keep them sharp (rounded-none or rounded-sm) to match the cyber aesthetic.
Integrate Lucide-react for icons. Use toxic green colored icons for primary actions.
Use framer-motion for page transitions and micro-interactions (glitch effects, floating elements).
Build the cinematic intro as a full-screen overlay component that renders before the main app. Check sessionStorage to ensure it only plays once per session.
The persistent audio player must be built in a layout wrapper so it persists across page navigations.
In the Admin panel, respect the dark mode. Use Shadcn datatables but style them with black backgrounds and white/green borders.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='play-track-button', data-testid='skip-intro-button').
Ensure all copy is in Romanian as specified in the brief.
For the glitch effect on titles, implement custom CSS in your index.css to create text-shadow shifts or translate animations on hover.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use transparent backgrounds on headers or overlays; always apply a blur or semi-solid background (e.g., bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md).
Never apply 'transition: all' universally. Apply specific transitions like 'transition-colors' or 'transition-transform'.
Do not center-align app containers (.App { text-align: center }). Use proper structural layouts.
Use layered z-index hierarchy effectively. Background (noise) -> Base UI -> Glassmorphism Cards -> Sticky Nav -> Modals/Overlays.
Do not use generic assistant emojis. Use professional SVGs or Lucide icons.
Apply generous spacing (p-6, p-8 minimum for large sections) to allow the cyber/toxic visual assets to breathe.
Use sonner for all toast notifications, styled with the dark toxic theme.
